name: Caribbean Liberation
description: The Blue Fleet's fight for freedom of the Caribbean seas - a tale of naval mastery and strategic brilliance

briefing_override: CARIBBEAN LIBERATION - Chapter 1
Enemy privateers have been raiding our merchant convoys.
Your mission: Hunt them down and sink their ships.
This is your first command, Admiral.
Show them the might of the Blue Fleet!
Use WASD or Arrow Keys to move camera
Click ships to select, click destinations to move
Right-click enemies to attack
CARIBBEAN LIBERATION - Chapter 2
The enemy has fortified a strategic island.
Your fleet has been reinforced with powerful warships.
Assault the fortress and break their defensive line.
Remember: Ships of the Line have superior firepower.
Frigates can bombard from long range.
Victory here will open the central shipping lanes!
CARIBBEAN LIBERATION - Chapter 3
This is the decisive battle for Caribbean supremacy.
Three islands. Multiple enemy fleets. One outcome.
The enemy has concentrated their forces.
Your tactical brilliance will determine the war's outcome.
Use the deep channels to divide their forces.
Coordinate your ships for maximum effect.
Good luck, Admiral. The Caribbean watches!
CARIBBEAN LIBERATION - Final Chapter
The enemy's legendary admiral challenges you.
This is the ultimate test of naval warfare mastery.
Defeat him and the Caribbean is ours!
Optional: Complete this for the ultimate victory!

victory_text: The Blue Fleet has achieved total naval supremacy.
The Caribbean seas are now free and safe.
Your brilliant tactics have brought peace to the region.
You will be remembered as one of history's greatest admirals!
Thank you for playing Caribbean Naval Warfare!
